description: This file appears to be a PHP script for handling file uploads within the vtiger CRM system, specifically related to creating or managing word templates. It sets up dependencies, handles request parameters, assigns variables to the Smarty templating engine, and displays a template for the user interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating engine class used within vtiger CRM, instantiated to render templates.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the specified Smarty template for the response.
